title: Fiber cut on Hervanta backbone
description: Construction work damaged a backbone fiber cable. Traffic rerouted, cable spliced.

title: DNS resolution failures
description: Intermittent DNS timeouts caused by a resolver cache issue.

title: 5G service degradation
description: Network degradation affecting 5G customers. Three gNodeB sites in Kallio and Sörnäinen report high packet loss after a software upgrade.

title: Packet loss on fixed broadband
description: Aggregation router in Oulu city centre shows 3-5% packet loss during peak hours.

title: IPTV buffering
description: Multicast stream buffering on two channels. Fix deployed, monitoring.

title: Voicemail platform latency
description: Voicemail retrieval takes up to 30 seconds for customers registered on the Espoo platform node.
